memo:
EdgeHound Performance Review — 2026-06-18

Portfolio is down 6.77% from inception with equity at $9,323 on an $10,000 start. Realized P&L is -$825 across 86 closed trades. The signal picture is now meaningfully differentiated: SHORT_FAVORITE is the clear profit engine (+$508, 23W/35T, 65.7% win rate) with a validated hypothesis showing 68.8% win rate on high-priced sports markets. VOLUME_SPIKE is marginally positive (+$190) but with wide dispersion — a single large win on the Iran agreement text release flatters the aggregate. MOMENTUM is the primary destroyer (-$1,019, 8W/21T, 38% win rate) and correctly remains disabled. SMART_CONSENSUS has one trade and a large loss (-$385), appropriately disabled. ELITE_FOLLOW is modestly negative (-$119) with a mixed record; the Iran-related trades show erratic sizing — a $550 stake on an Israel-Iran peace deal at 9.85 cents is a calibration failure that should not recur.

Key concern this session: SHORT_FAVORITE is taking $750 stakes on esports (Dota 2, LoL) where two consecutive stop-losses of -$470 and -$503 hit within 1 hour. Esports favorites exhibit different variance profiles versus traditional sports — the validated hypothesis is sports-specific and esports may be contaminating the edge. The Brier score of 0.264 is weak, suggesting model probability estimates need tightening. kellyMult at 0.15 is conservative and appropriate given ongoing calibration uncertainty. No parameter changes are warranted this session — the sample on ELITE_FOLLOW and VOLUME_SPIKE remains too small to act on, and SHORT_FAVORITE's edge is confirmed. Flag esports exposure as a structural risk.
observations: SHORT_FAVORITE: validated edge on sports, 68.8% win rate, +$508 PnL — the portfolio's only reliable alpha source
MOMENTUM: correctly disabled, was responsible for -$1,019; no evidence of edge recovery
SMART_CONSENSUS: disabled, single large loss (-$385), insufficient data to reinstate

ELITE_FOLLOW: net -$119 across 9 trades; positive on small Iran momentum trades but two large-stake disasters ($550 on Israel-Iran peace at 0.0985 entry, -$142; $550 on Trump troops withdrawal, -$167) — sizing discipline failure
VOLUME_SPIKE: +$190 headline number flatters a 40% win rate; one outlier trade (+$479) is masking consistent small losses on political markets

Esports contamination risk: two SHORT_FAVORITE stop-losses in esports (Dota2 -$470, LoL -$503) within 1-hour holds — esports favorite pricing does not share the same mean-reversion profile as traditional sports
Brier score 0.264 is poor; predicted probabilities (pPredicted 0.57-0.70) are not well-calibrated against outcomes
Soccer 'draw' markets being traded as SHORT_FAVORITE with max-hold exits near entry — no edge observed, P&L breakeven but consuming capital and exposure slots
Current equity $9,323 with 5 open positions totaling $2,600 staked — exposure is manageable
kellyMult 0.15 and maxExposure 0.40 are appropriately conservative given calibration uncertainty
changeReasoning: No parameter changes made this session. SHORT_FAVORITE is the only validated engine and current settings (pMin 0.57, kellyMult 0.15) are already conservative and appropriate. ELITE_FOLLOW and VOLUME_SPIKE have fewer than 15 settled trades each in their forming hypotheses — adjusting based on current data would be noise-chasing. The sizing failures in ELITE_FOLLOW (large stakes on ultra-low-probability political markets) appear to be a model miscalibration issue rather than a parameter fix — the pMin filter should be catching 0.0985 entry prices, suggesting the pPredicted estimate of 0.64 on the Israel-Iran peace deal was grossly miscalibrated. This warrants monitoring but not a mechanical parameter change. Maintaining current conservative posture until Brier score improves and ELITE_FOLLOW/VOLUME_SPIKE accumulate 15+ settled trades per hypothesis.
riskFlags: CRITICAL: Esports markets being traded under SHORT_FAVORITE hypothesis validated only on traditional sports — two consecutive max stop-losses suggest the edge does not transfer; recommend adding market-category filter or blacklisting esports from SHORT_FAVORITE

CALIBRATION FAILURE: ELITE_FOLLOW placed $550 stake on Israel-Iran peace deal at 0.0985 market price with pPredicted=0.64 — a 55-point gap between model and market is a red flag for model overfitting or data contamination; review ELITE_FOLLOW scoring logic
VOLUME_SPIKE edge is not confirmed — 50% win rate with wide CI; the +$190 PnL is driven by a single outlier; consider reducing VOLUME_SPIKE maxEventExposure if next 5 trades continue losing
Soccer draw markets generating flat/negative P&L with max-hold exits — consuming exposure slots without edge; review whether draw markets should be excluded from SHORT_FAVORITE signal
Brier score 0.264 indicates systematic probability miscalibration; predicted win probabilities are not matching outcomes — model needs recalibration before kellyMult increases are considered
